feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 10 May 2026 11:44am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 10 May 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure over the Irish Sea will decline later today, allowing a weak weather front to move southwards across the area later tonight and at first tomorrow.


##Wind##

Between North and East 2 to 4 at first, but gradually backing and increasing North or Northwest 4 or 5 through the afternoon and evening. Increasing Northwest 5 occasionally 6 tonight, veering and decreasing North or Northeast 4 or 5 late in the night or at first tomorrow morning, 3 or 4 later in the morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building slight or moderate later today, slight later tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Fair, then light showery rain later tonight and at first tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in any showery rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northeast 3 or 4, backing North or Northwest through tomorrow afternoon and evening, occasionally 5 in north of area. Backing West 4 or 5 in all waters overnight into Tuesday, West or Northwest 5 or 6 on Tuesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair, then patchy light rain and drizzle for a time around dawn on Tuesday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in any light rain and drizzle.
